reviewer_statement: Developer-side source-semantic scientific review based on frozen Python 1.2, full mathematical outputs and row/field geometry, input/boundary cases and direct source-typed differential tests committed. Cross-platform and pinned-Python exact-head GitHub Actions remain queued; this is not independent scientific certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Source mathematical result represented in native R scientific arrays/data.frames, with source-specific input mode where needed, not Python runtime object identity. Source-shaped result validation is not an assertion of upstream optimizer parity or Python exception class matching.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python FPCA-compatible score matrix and optional retained component count; native R scientific list or fitted FPCA result with an explicit Python boundary mode. No Python inference or refitting.

Finite dense and SciPy-like sparse FPCA scores, non-square curve-by-component source arrays, integer one-to-k slicing and source overdeclared metadata using actual available columns, sparse Boolean arrays.

Frozen sklearn pairwise Euclidean distances over retained FPCA score columns: Gram/squared norms, nonnegative squared distance clamp, zero diagonal, symmetric unlabelled n-curves-square matrix, complete dense and sparse Python oracle values.
Invalid fractional slice index, negative and out-of-range k, nonfinite score entries, zero score dimensions and bounded native dense-output resource protection.
Unlabelled real symmetric numeric square R matrix matching Python ndarray values and row/column ordering, with exact zero diagonal and no extraneous metadata or provenance.
Euclidean pairwise distance on explicitly retained principal-component score coordinates, conditional on the source fit, not similarity based on curves or a newly estimated FPCA basis.

independent_review_status: Provisional author-reviewed with exact SHA256 provenance, no independent certification; exact-head CI pending.
language_specific_limits: R default preserves the more numerically stable stats::dist path; exact sklearn source arithmetic and integer coercion are explicitly selected by python_boundary_mode=TRUE.

R source mode applies a 5,000,000-cell dense output resource bound; source Python accepts operations until host memory exhaustion. This is an operational safety bound, not a different distance estimand.
Native sparse Matrix classes replace SciPy CSR identity and error classes; no independent certification yet.
